info.name: PitchTZ Client API Copy
info.description:
The mobile handover contract for the PitchTZ player experience. Every
operation in this document is **deployed and live today** — this spec is
generated from the running router, not a wishlist.

**See it all working first:** the client web at
https://pitchtz.flutterai.dev is the reference implementation of this API.
Booking with hold countdown, split QR payments, teams & open challenges,
Google-Maps discovery, watch areas with the live match board, the shop,
reviews — every flow below can be exercised there end-to-end before you
write a line of mobile code.

Conventions:
- Every response is wrapped: `{ "success": bool, "data": …, "message": str }`
  on success and `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message" } }` on failure.
- Money is integer Tanzanian shillings (no decimals).
- Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC; display times in Africa/Dar_es_Salaam (+03:00).
- Auth is a Bearer JWT from email-code verify or the social redirect flow.
  Client tokens live 30 days; exchange via `/auth/refresh` past half-life.
- Payment method logos/operators come from the companion Malipo gateway:
  `GET https://api.malipo.flutterai.dev/v1/providers/active` (no auth).

Excluded on purpose: venue-owner, superadmin and provider-webhook APIs.

response.name: Cities ordered as stored; filter by `status`.

request.description:
Returns blocked windows (bookings, holds, slot blocks) per pitch for
the requested range. Build the slot grid client-side from the venue's
`open_hours` (empty object = default 08:00–23:00), marking any slot
that overlaps an unavailable window. `kind: processing` means someone
is paying for that slot right now — show it orange, not bookable.

item.name: Pay half now, settle the rest in cash at the venue

request.description:
Charges ceil(total/2) to one mobile-money number and flags the booking
`balance_at_venue`. Once the deposit settles the booking is CONFIRMED
with `balance_due_tzs` payable at the gate. Only available before any
other payment has started.

item.name: Hold a slot on a specific pitch

request.description:
Bookings are per **pitch**, never per venue. A successful call places a
10-minute hold (`hold_expires_at`); pay within it or the slot releases.
Money safety is server-side: a charge that completes after the hold
expired still wins the slot back.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

item.name: Match centre: scorers, cards, half-time, lineups — or the F1 podium

request.description:
On-demand detail for one fixture, cached 60s server-side. Football and
basketball return a `timeline` (minute, type: goal/own_goal/penalty_goal/
yellow_card/red_card/substitution, player, running score) plus
`half_time`; football adds `lineups`. F1 returns `results` (position,
driver, team, points). Only meaningful once the match has started.

item.name: Match board (next 7 days plus the last 6 hours)

query.description: Exact league name, for example `Ligi Kuu Bara`.
One calendar day in East Africa Time (Africa/Dar_es_Salaam).

request.description:
Tanzania's Ligi Kuu Bara plus Europe's top five leagues and basketball
(NBA / WNBA / FIBA). Includes live scores when matches are in play and,
when an optional Bearer token is supplied, marks fixtures involving a
saved team with `is_favorite: true`.

Fetch one window and filter dates client-side where practical. Poll at
most every 60 seconds, and only while at least one returned fixture has
`live: true`; stop polling as soon as no live fixture remains. The
server refreshes its source every 2 minutes during live windows.

Data courtesy of LiveScore — keep the credit visible in your UI.
